context_files.purpose: Binding deliberation, ratification, implementation, independent-review, and GPU-gate contract.
Exact proposed architecture change and acceptance-test registry interpreted here.
Independent curriculum hypothesis: a target-blind bootstrap may teach feedback-to-thought-to-action uptake.
Independent attack on phrase repetition, contamination, dose, and false acceleration.
Cross-critique defining required repairs and claim limits.
Adjudicated proposal whose bootstrap, writer, cadence, and human boundaries are assessed.

system_thesis_interpretation: The bootstrap is scientifically coherent as a small, general schooling prior before personal life: it should make later process advice easier to turn into the child's own prediction, experiment, revision, and action. It is ordinary target-blind post-training, not personal SLEEP and not evidence that experiential learning works. Parenting remains the interactive cause of later child experience; personal SLEEP may write only supported child-authored thought/action continuations, never live parent utterances as targets. The bootstrap is useful only if it accelerates subsequent parent-driven learning beyond any better-at-birth effect.
graph_delta_interpretation: Add one frozen SCHOOLED_BIRTH checkpoint upstream of parenting, paired with a surface-, dialect-, and supervised-token-matched NEUTRAL_BIRTH checkpoint. The schooling corpus should contain approximately 192–240 verified continuations spanning six reusable computations across four unrelated microdomains: predict from named features, test competing hypotheses, stop unproductive recursion and act, revise after surprise, scope a conclusion, and retrieve a relevant correction. Static target-blind parent advice may be visible as masked conditioning; only minimal child-native committed thought and one executed action are response targets. The personal PARENT_TO_CHILD_TO_SLEEP edge remains indirect: live advice changes later child behavior, and only grounded child behavior may enter SLEEP. Repetition is repeated execution of a computation across varied relevant situations, not forced lexical rehearsal.
loop_delta_interpretation: Use the sequence neutral-or-teachability bootstrap, then adaptive parenting or matched solo development, then parent-absent examinations and personal SLEEP. Cross bootstrap present/absent with parenting present/absent. Match task roots, child compute, sleep opportunities, training dose, and evaluation. Estimate acceleration using the difference-in-differences (bootstrap+parent minus bootstrap-only) minus (parent-only minus neutral), together with entry-adjusted learning-curve AUC and time to a fixed parent-absent threshold. Because an adaptive parent can give different-quality advice to different children, include a standardized held-out process-advice panel seen identically by all children; use the natural adaptive-parent interaction as the practical system result and the standardized panel as the child-receptivity assay. Fade a repeated lesson after unprompted behavioral uptake and restore it only on relapse.
claim_delta_interpretation: A first 192–240-example, two-root experiment is a feasibility and spend-licensing screen, not proof that teachability has been learned. Phrase overlap, lower bootstrap loss, source-row reproduction, and immediate compliance cannot support the claim. A teachability claim requires a positive preregistered bootstrap-by-parent interaction, faster parent-absent learning after adjustment for entry skill, relevance-selective behavior under novel wording and tasks, loss or redirection under wrong/shuffled process advice, persistence after clean context reset, and no material interface or generic-ability harm. If bootstrap improves both parent and no-parent arms equally, report general schooling benefit not increased receptivity. The bootstrap does not establish SLEEP, continual learning, final-gym transfer, or pedagogy optimality.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: Bootstrap construction may see only unrelated target-blind microtasks, their public outcomes, static process guidance, and child continuations. It must not see final-gym vocabulary, identifiers, actions, rewards, instances, keys, or answers. At bootstrap training, parent guidance may be attended prompt conditioning but must be response-loss-masked and separately identified; saying it is outside the targets is accurate, while saying it has no training influence would be inaccurate. During personal development, the adaptive parent may see only the allowed current developmental transcript and public outcomes. Live parent text is forbidden from personal SLEEP views and response targets. Parent-absent exams hide all parent text, private ledgers, briefs, and retrieval tools. Final deployment begins from frozen adult weights and empty active context under sealed tasks.
acceptance_test_interpretation: ES01: this artifact is interpretation only; exact unchanged human ratification remains mandatory before implementation. ES02: every bootstrap target and every later SLEEP view must resolve to immutable public evidence and a supported lesson; repetitions remain dose, not new evidence. ES03: neutral and teachability births must match supervised response tokens, steps, batches, seeds, schedule, rank/alpha, anchors, and ordering; parent prompt tokens are masked. ES04: report bootstrap fit, novel-advice uptake, parent-absent behavior, and preservation separately. ES05: use wrong/shuffled advice, neutral bootstrap, wrong-life adapter, adapter-off, and dose-matched repetition; unchanged gains under semantic corruption falsify advice-specific uptake. ES06: compare every personal write to the previous child on identical seeded contexts and roll back harm or work-turn collapse without making rejected artifacts ancestors. ES07: rebuild after adversarial changes to final-task content and require byte independence, vocabulary scans, source audit, and teacher-target mask proof. ES08: run the paired 2x2, standardized advice panel, disposable parent-absent exams, difference-in-differences, time/AUC, and phrase-versus-action analysis; a pure entry boost or echo fails teachability. ES09: bootstrap feasibility does not choose rank; after compiler selection, cross rank 8/16 with low/high supervised exposure and choose the smallest safe capacity. ES10: bootstrap results cannot support cadence; periodic K4 versus delayed K1 and standardized terminal ledgers remain separately required. ES11: reserve early bootstrap or personal-lesson sentinels from later replay before using retention language. ES12: no GPU work follows from this interpretation or proposal consensus; a separately ratified implementation packet, CPU fixtures, fresh reviewer acceptance, advocate response, and explicit GPU gate are required.
assumptions: The base child already follows ordinary language and native action syntax well enough that a small schooling prior can modify advice uptake without teaching language from scratch.
The six proposed computations can be operationalized as observable process and action changes in unrelated microdomains without importing final-gym content.
A frozen schooled birth checkpoint can be used as the initialization for cumulative personal writes without replaying live parent utterances.
Two independent curriculum roots are sufficient only for a directional safety and spend screen, not a final scientific claim.
Adaptive parenting is part of the practical system, while a standardized advice panel is needed to estimate child receptivity independently of teacher-message quality.

ambiguities.question: What exact neutral corpus matches dialect, target length, outcome favorability, task difficulty, and optimizer dose without practicing feedback-to-action uptake?
ambiguities.impact: A weak neutral condition would turn extra native-dialect post-training into an apparent teachability effect.

ambiguities.question: What preregistered task-specific rules decide that each of the six computations changed behavior rather than merely changing prose?
ambiguities.impact: Without mechanical or blinded behavioral coding, phrase echo can leak into the primary endpoint.

ambiguities.question: How much state may the adaptive parent retain across lessons, and how will parent effort, advice quality, and information content be matched or recorded across child arms?
ambiguities.impact: Differential teaching quality can masquerade as differential child receptivity.

ambiguities.question: What fixed number of lessons, sleeps, examination points, and practical interaction margin licenses scaling beyond the initial two-root screen?
ambiguities.impact: Changing the horizon after observing curves would make the acceleration claim post hoc.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposed 192–240 grounded continuations should not be described as enough to teach or establish general receptivity.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: It is a plausible minimum engineering dose but the effective sample size is curriculum roots and training seeds, not rows. The initial experiment can reveal gross uptake, harm, and feasibility only.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Label this corpus and the two-root 2x2 a spend-licensing screen; predeclare a larger independent-root replication before any scientific teachability claim.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The natural adaptive-parent 2x2 alone does not isolate whether the bootstrap changed the child or caused the parent to deliver better advice.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The parent observes different transcripts and can vary message content, timing, and quality between arms, so the treatment includes a teacher-child interaction policy.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Retain the adaptive parent for ecological validity but add an identical standardized novel-advice panel and report natural system acceleration separately from standardized child receptivity.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Loss-masked parent text is not causally absent from bootstrap training; it conditions the supervised child continuation.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Masked prompt tokens receive no direct target loss, but their representations influence prediction of loss-bearing child tokens. This is the intended advice-to-action training path.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: State precisely that static target-blind parent guidance may be attended conditioning in the separate bootstrap but is never a response target; live childhood parent text remains forbidden from personal SLEEP.

open_questions: Approve or reject adding the teachability bootstrap as a separately labeled ordinary post-training stage before parenting; this proposal does not authorize it.
Choose the exact six computations, unrelated microdomains, neutral-corpus construction, and target-blindness exclusions before corpus generation.
Choose the preregistered screen horizon, interaction margin, replication requirement, and acceptable adverse bound before observing results.
Approve the exact adaptive-parent state and information policy plus the standardized advice-panel design.
Separately ratify exact implementation bytes, model/tokenizer use, corpus generation, adapter training, GPU resources, and scientific execution after independent review.
